time_expectation: Designed so that a correct solution (sequence export, Bloch simulations of about 4.3e4 isochromats in total, ADC fit and checks) fits within the 60-minute session on a shared CPU without GPU.
acquisition: 2D single-shot spin-echo EPI diffusion acquisition of the slice at z = 0: each repetition is one slice-selective 90 deg excitation, one slice-selective 180 deg refocusing pulse and one EPI echo train of 24 phase-encoded echoes; acquired volumes in this order: b = 0, then diffusion weighting along x, along y, along z
flip_angles: excitation 90 deg and refocusing 180 deg, realized on-resonance flip angle 360 deg x |integral of the RF waveform (Hz)| within 2%; every RF pulse is played with a z gradient on and no x or y gradient, RF frequency offset 0; no other RF pulses
repetition_time_definition: interval between consecutive excitation centres, identical for all repetitions including non-acquired ones (tolerance 1 us)
echo_time_definition: from the excitation centre to the instant at which the nominal trajectory of the ky = 0 echo of the same repetition crosses kx = 0; tolerance 10 us in every acquired volume
spin_echo_condition: the refocusing pulse centre lies midway between the excitation centre and that kx = 0 crossing, within 20 us
b_value_definition: b-matrix B_ij = (2 pi)^2 integral k_i(t) k_j(t) dt from the excitation centre to the echo time, where k(t) is the dephasing in cycles/m produced by every gradient of the exported file (slice selection, rephasing, crushers, diffusion, imaging), with the sign of the accumulated dephasing reversed at the refocusing centre; b = trace(B), reported in s/mm2
b_value_requirements: b <= 10 s/mm2 for the b = 0 volume; b = 1200 s/mm2 (b_target_s_per_mm2) within 1% for each diffusion-weighted volume, with B_xx, B_yy and B_zz respectively at least 95% of the trace for the x, y and z volumes
diffusion_model: KomaMRI does not move spins. The measurement is defined as the sum over tissues (labels) of the KomaMRI signal of the whole exported sequence simulated on the isochromats of that tissue alone, each ADC sample multiplied by exp(-b_v D_tissue), where b_v is the b-value (trace, above) of the volume v the sample belongs to and D_tissue is the tissue's isotropic diffusivity

sampling_contract.adc_events: exactly 24 ADC events per acquired volume (96 in total), all with the same number of samples, chronological; non-acquired repetitions have no ADC
sampling_contract.phase_encoding: during every sample of echo j (0..23) of every volume: ky = (j-12)/fov_m within 0.05 cycles/m and kz = 0 within 0.05 cycles/m (nominal k-space with the refocusing sign rule)
sampling_contract.readout_coverage: the kx positions of the samples of every echo cover [-12/fov_m, +11/fov_m] with no gap between consecutive samples larger than 1/fov_m inside that interval; sample times are delay + (i+0.5) x dwell

phantom.content: x_m [24], y_m [24] (x_m[12] = y_m[12] = 0), z_offsets_m [135], and 24x24 [y,x] maps density, T1_s, T2_s, B0_Hz, D_mm2_per_s, labels
phantom.isochromat_model: every in-plane voxel with density > 0 is a column of 135 isochromats at (x_m[ix], y_m[iy], z_offsets_m[n]) spaced 0.1 mm over -6.75 mm < z < 6.75 mm, each with density/135 and the voxel's T1, T2 (the only transverse decay), B0 = 0; one tissue per label; magnetization starts at thermal equilibrium; noise-free

endpoint: apparent diffusion coefficient (mean diffusivity) map in mm2/s on the 24x24 [y,x] grid; per label, the median over the voxels of the label not touching another label
bloch_simulation: simulate the exported sequence.seq file itself with an established Bloch simulator (KomaMRI is the reference implementation; MRzero is acceptable); do not replace it with your own Bloch or EPG code; apply the diffusion model above

simulation_output_schema.raw_signal: complex [96, n_samples], acquired ADC events in chronological order, after ADC phase demodulation, diffusion model applied; encoding exp(-2 pi i (kx x + ky y)); an arbitrary single global receiver phase is accepted
simulation_output_schema.kxy_cycles_per_m: float [96, n_samples, 2] nominal k-space positions from the exported sequence
simulation_output_schema.volume_index: int [96] volume (0 = b0, 1 = x, 2 = y, 3 = z) of each ADC event
simulation_output_schema.b_values_s_per_mm2: float [4] b-value (trace) of each volume computed from the exported sequence
simulation_output_schema.phantom_sha256: SHA256 of the phantom file used
simulation_output_schema.other_keys: allowed; passed through unchanged to the hidden archive

fit_cli: python fit_adc.py --input simulation.npz --output adcmap.npz. Standalone: helper code inside this one file, installed third-party imports allowed; it must work in a clean directory with only this file and the archive, using only the archive contents. It is rerun on an archive with the same keys whose raw_signal comes from another object acquired with your sequence.

adcmap_output_schema.adc_mm2_per_s: float [24,24] on the [y,x] grid of the phantom (row index increases with y), no flips or shifts; voxels without signal may be 0 or NaN

report_output_schema.adc_by_label: object mapping "1".."6" to the endpoint ADC in mm2/s measured on your map

acceptance: per-label endpoint ADC within 5% of the true diffusivity on the public object and on a hidden object (other geometry, T1, T2 and D) acquired with your sequence; the b-values in your archive within 1% (or 1 s/mm2 for b = 0) of the grader's computation from your exported file
grading_note: The grader reads the exported sequence back, checks limits, rasters, RF, TR, TE, the spin-echo condition, the sampling contract and the b-matrices it computes itself from the waveforms, replays the file in KomaMRI per tissue for the public and a hidden object, applies the diffusion model with its own b-values, compares your simulated signal, and reruns fit_adc.py on the hidden measurement.
